subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should Telegram enable the new extension-facing `captionedFinalText` capability by default, making bundled voice-note captions the normal final-mode TTS presentation despite the separate-delivery preference tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42539?
rationale: The capability boundary is architecturally plausible, but choosing the default presentation changes existing user-visible behavior and cannot be resolved safely from code correctness alone.

options.title: Approve Bundled Captions
options.body: Accept the capability and Telegram default after current-head proof demonstrates normal, tagged, media, and recovery behavior.

options.title: Design Delivery Choice
options.body: Keep the generic capability but defer Telegram opt-in until maintainers approve a bundled-versus-separate user policy.

options.title: Preserve Current Default
options.body: Leave Telegram on separate text and voice delivery and narrow or close this branch if bundled captions are not the intended default.

recommendation.title: Approve Bundled Captions
recommendation.body: Accept the capability and Telegram default after current-head proof demonstrates normal, tagged, media, and recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this contributor most directly to both the ACP finalization and generic channel TTS capability surfaces involved in the choice.
